questions.explanation: 根据上下文语境，12岁的Meenah花时间做手工，并将其视为一种爱好。have a passion for是固定表达，意为“对……有极大的热情/热爱”，符合句意。

questions.explanation: 主语 The three-floor structure 与 build 构成被动关系，且时间状语 in the 1920s 表示过去，故使用一般过去时的被动语态。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was built)：语境句：The famous bridge was built over a hundred years ago. 固定搭配：build up, build a house。原词build其它变形：builder(n. 建筑者), building(n. 建筑物).

questions.explanation: 此处为介词 to 后面的宾语从句。从句 it originally looked like 中，介词 like 后面缺少宾语，因此用 what 引导该从句，意为“它最初的样子”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(what)：语境句：He finally realized what he had lost. 固定搭配：what matters most, what happened。

questions.explanation: 句中已有谓语 looks，此处用非谓语动词作状语。主语 it 与 feature（以……为特色）是主动关系，故填现在分词 Featuring。注意句首字母需大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(Featuring)：语境句：Featuring a stunning sea view, the hotel is very popular among tourists. 固定搭配：feature film, distinctive feature。原词feature其它变形：featureless(adj. 无特色的).

questions.explanation: 此处泛指“一座欧洲城堡”，需填不定冠词。European 虽然首字母是元音字母，但发音以辅音 /j/ 开头，故使用 a 而非 an。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：He is studying at a European university. 固定搭配：a useful tool, a unique experience。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词短语 old look，需用形容词性物主代词。指代前文的 structure/house，故填 its。
questions.supplement: 正确形(its)：语境句：The dog wagged its tail when it saw its owner. 固定搭配：its origin, its own。原词it其它变形：itself(反身代词).

questions.explanation: take/make efforts to do sth 是固定搭配，意为“努力做某事”，此处需用动词不定式作后置定语或目的状语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to find)：语境句：They took great efforts to find the missing child. 固定搭配：find out, find it difficult to do。原词find其它变形：finding(n. 发现, 多用复数), found(过去式/过去分词).

questions.explanation: 空后 skills 为名词，需用形容词进行修饰。convention 的形容词形式是 conventional，意为“传统的、常规的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(conventional)：语境句：They used conventional methods to solve the new problem. 固定搭配：conventional wisdom, conventional weapons。原词convention其它变形：unconventional(adj. 非传统的), conventionally(adv. 按照惯例).

questions.explanation: 句中已有谓语 has opened，此处需填非谓语动词作后置定语。the house 与 name（命名）之间是被动关系，故填过去分词 named，相当于 which is named。
questions.supplement: 正确形(named)：语境句：They visited a small town named after a famous poet. 固定搭配：name after, by name。原词name其它变形：namely(adv. 即, 也就是), nameless(adj. 无名的).

questions.explanation: appeal to sb 为固定搭配，意为“对某人有吸引力，引起某人的兴趣”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to)：语境句：The idea of living in the countryside doesn't appeal to me. 固定搭配：appeal to the public, lose its appeal。

questions.explanation: 位于物主代词 their 之后，且由 and 与名词 inclusiveness（包容性）并列，需填 open 的名词形式 openness，意为“开放（度）”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(openness)：语境句：The company was praised for its openness to new ideas. 固定搭配：with openness, openness to experience。原词open其它变形：opening(n. 缺口/开始), openly(adv. 公开地).
